headline: Paychex (PAYX) Board Change And Dividend Stand Out, Is It Fully Priced?
summary: Paychex (PAYX) is in focus after director Kara Wilson chose not to stand for re election in 2026. The Board also affirmed a regular quarterly cash dividend of $1.19 per share.
